Q1 2023 | Company Update

FINANCING
Targeting a Series B in February, if the round comes together. Stay disciplined; don't treat timing as certain.

OPERATING TIMELINE
We shipped a lot in Q4, even if execution didn't feel clean. Q1 is the bridge; Q3 is the real push. Focus the plan on what we can finish and validate before then.

HIRING
Don't get ahead of the plan on hiring. Map the exact headcount need and what changes at 14 people versus 12; avoid adding roles before onboarding capacity and financing visibility support it.
